title: ESUN Dissector
description:
This is a dissector for the new ESUN header format.

Registered as experimental ethertype 0x88B5

I do not think we want to register anything to a "Local Experimental Ethertype" for public distribution. I think it would be better to add this with `dissector_add_for_decode_as` and require people interested in ESUN to use Decode As (and optionally save it to their configuration profile.)

commits_data.title: ESUN Dissector
commits_data.message:
ESUN Dissector

Registered as experimental ethertype 0x88B5

ESUN: Modernize dissector and use "Decode As" for ethertype

- Remove explicit initialization of protocol and field handles.
- Use standard C types (int, bool) instead of GLib types (gint, gboolean).
- Update single-byte field encoding to ENC_NA.
- Replace fixed ethertype registration with "Decode As" support.
